title: Research 8/9: Graeber-Wengrow steelman against the roadmap's linearity (mandated contrarian vaccine)
description: Mandated by roadmap Part VII (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:117, 'assign at least one research agent to steelman this critique against the roadmap') and Part V principle 4 (line 95). Build the strongest available case AGAINST the roadmap's premise that agent systematization recapitulates a linear state-formation sequence (charismatic to bureaucratic to legal-rational order). Draw on Graeber and Wengrow, The Dawn of Everything: seasonal dual morphology and political experimentation, the critique of the agriculture-to-state stage sequence, schismogenesis, the indigenous critique, and the claim that hierarchy was often deliberately reversible rather than an evolutionary endpoint. Then apply it: does the ability of agents to fork at decision points, merge branches of experience, and share state directly make the state-formation playbook a local optimum that flatters human imagination? Output docs/precedent-research/08-graeber-wengrow-steelman.md. Web research, tagged claims, mandatory implications section.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE (create only this; touch no other file): docs/precedent-research/08-graeber-wengrow-steelman.md. Create the parent directory with mkdir -p (idempotent and race-safe: the nine research tasks run in parallel, share no file, and no bootstrap root serializes them). Do NOT create or edit docs/precedent-research/README.md - that index is owned solely by the epic join T-348 (F1 single-owner rule).

WEB RESEARCH IS REQUIRED (coordinator decision D7): at least 5 named sources, of which at least 3 are primary (a judgment with its case name and citation, a statute or code article, an official practice statement or court rule, or a named-author treatise / peer-reviewed article). Every source is listed in a final Sources section with a retrievable identifier (case name plus citation, or URL plus retrieval date). Parametric-only claims with no locatable source are tagged SPECULATION, never ESTABLISHED.

EVERY substantive claim carries exactly one tag: ESTABLISHED (attributable to a named source in the Sources section), ANALOGY (a mapping from legal doctrine onto agent mechanics - the mapping is this agent's inference, not the source's claim), or SPECULATION (neither). An untagged substantive claim is a defect and grounds for REJECT. Basis: roadmap Part V principle 5, no fabricated rigor (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:96).

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Implications for the agent harness': map each finding onto the real substrate by name - blackboard task IDs (T-xxx), the three roles (thinker, worker, verifier) plus coordinator, and the four authority tiers of coordinator decision D4 (1 operator, 2 constitutional, 3 verdicted, 4 single-agent). For each finding state which schema field, CLI subcommand, or protocol rule it demands, or state explicitly that it demands none.

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Extends, does not duplicate': for every doctrine that already has a partial implementation in this repo, cite it by file:line and say whether the finding EXTENDS the existing record or would DUPLICATE it. The candidates the scout already located: note taxonomy DECISION/DEVIATION/TRADEOFF/OPEN-QUESTION (ORCHESTRATION.md:69-77), the reopen verb with its mandatory-reasoning gate (.harness/bin/blackboard.py:470-517, ORCHESTRATION.md:58-67), the P-number ledger (state.json evolution.accepted_mutations), prose P-number citations in ORCHESTRATION.md, recontext.py append-only cited-evidence log, events.jsonl semantic event floor. Rationale: the corpus records a measured non-additive interaction where stacking one more layer that re-does existing verification REGRESSED performance (papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:8, Table 3 RQ3a, '+ system_prompt only' -2.3pp; p.9 'Components interact non-additively').

MANDATORY: state at least one finding that CUTS AGAINST the roadmap brief or the coordinator decision memo where the sources support one. If the sources support none, say so explicitly and say why - a document with zero friction against its own commissioning brief is treated as unverified cheerleading.
NO CODE and NO edits under .harness/ or to PRECEDENT.md. Research tasks have no build dependencies and must create none.

Verification tier: DOC TIER per P-024 (proportional verification) - the verifier does a BRIEF replay (file exists at the exact path; every substantive claim tagged; Sources section present with the required counts; the two mandatory sections present; spot-check that 2 named sources exist), NOT a full adversarial replay. Hand off with blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier (never self-mark done). The handoff note must name the 3 findings that most change the schema, each with the tag it carries.

MUST state the strongest version of 'do not build the precedent layer at all' as a real argument, not a straw man - including the cheapest alternative it implies (for example: keep decisions as disposable memos, rebuild consensus per session, accept churn as the price of adaptability).

MUST produce FALSIFIABLE TESTS: what observable evidence in this harness would decide between the state-formation reading and the critique. These signals feed the standing quarterly monitoring task T-349 and are consumed by T-344.

MUST deliver at least one CONCRETE DESIGN CONSEQUENCE if the critique is right - what the schema or protocol should do differently (for example: reversibility as a first-class field, a sunset default, cheap forking of the registry itself, a seasonal amnesty). A critique with no design consequence is not usable output.

MUST engage the corpus datapoint that a non-institutional coordination paradigm is live and published: papers/trinity.pdf demonstrates a trained coordination head routing thinker/worker/verifier roles with NO natural-language decision record, no citations and no declared ratio (see .harness/corpus-grounding-precedent-layer.md section 5f). State whether that is independent corroboration of the critique or a narrower problem that does not bear on it.

MUST also engage the counter-evidence honestly: the corpus records a path-dependent accumulated harness lineage beating every general-purpose alternative and then PLATEAUING (harness-optimization-reference/legal_agent_bench/HARNESSES.md:60-76, 30-31, 135-136 - clear plateau around 83% pooled, 'converged to a local ceiling'), which qualifies rather than refutes 'path dependence is the moat' (roadmap Part V principle 3).
